links.comparator_used: Same AI result without a box outlining the region of suspicion (Keep AI, No Box)
links.outcome: Radiologist false negative and false positive follow-up CT decisions when AI results were incorrect
links.effect: FN 20.7% with box vs 33.0% without box (p = 0.04); FP 80.5% with box vs 86.0% without box (key points report FPs also decreased; the abstract gives no p-value for this comparison)
links.tradeoff: Errors with the box were still higher than with no AI (FN 2.7%, FP 51.4%), so incorrect AI still caused more errors.
links.quote: FNs were higher in the Keep AI (No Box) condition (33.0%) than in the Keep AI (Box) condition (20.7%) (p = 0.04).
